extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet contains usable plotted family curves on p. 3. Curve points were manually digitized from visible plotted lines without interpolation from tabulated values.
The BZT52C3V0 electrical-characteristics row gives VZ minimum 2.85 V, nominal 3.0 V, and maximum 3.15 V at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 95 ohm at IZT and maximum ZZK is 600 ohm at IZK = 1 mA.
The p. 3 zener-characteristics plot contains a family trace near 3.0 V but does not label a 3.0 V trace, so no part-specific 3.0 V zener I-V points were transcribed.
The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 10 microA at VR = 1.0 V and maximum admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA.

The datasheet publishes typical capacitance family curves versus nominal zener voltage at 0 V bias, 1 V bias, and bias at 50 percent of nominal VZ, but it does not publish a single capacitance value for BZT52C3V0 at a specified reverse voltage, so specs.capacitance is null.
No reverse-recovery time or switching test is published, so specs.reverse_recovery is null.
The BZT52C3V0 temperature-coefficient limits are -3.5 to 0 mV/degC at IZTC; the p. 3 family temperature-coefficient curve is transcribed in V/degC.

The plotted capacitance, leakage, temperature-coefficient, and dynamic-impedance curves are typical family characteristics and should not be treated as guaranteed limits for the individual BZT52C3V0 part.
